hook: Monotone solutions of the anisotropic Allen-Cahn equation in 4D depend on one variable only.
summary: The paper proves the anisotropic version of De Giorgi's conjecture in four dimensions: monotone entire solutions that tend to plus or minus one at the ends are functions of one variable. It first shows that globally minimizing anisotropic surfaces are halfspaces, then uses a tilt-excess decay estimate and a Liouville argument. The result needs the limiting assumption at infinity and holds only in four dimensions.
title: The anisotropic De Giorgi conjecture in $\mathbb{R}^4$
